title: FSL FNIRT

affine_file.desc: name of file containing affine transform

apply_inmask.desc: list of iterations to use input mask on (1 to use, 0 to skip)

apply_intensity_mapping.desc: List of subsampling levels to apply intensity mapping for (0 to skip, 1 to apply)

apply_refmask.desc: list of iterations to use reference mask on (1 to use, 0 to skip)

bias_regularization_lambda.desc: Weight of regularisation for bias-field, default 10000

biasfield_resolution.desc: Resolution (in mm) of bias-field modelling local intensities, default 50, 50, 50

config_file.desc: Name of config file specifying command line arguments

derive_from_ref.desc: If true, ref image is used to calculate derivatives. Default false

field_file.desc: name of output file with field or true

fieldcoeff_file.desc: name of output file with field coefficients or true

hessian_precision.desc: Precision for representing Hessian, double or float. Default double

in_fwhm.desc: FWHM (in mm) of gaussian smoothing kernel for input volume, default [6, 4, 2, 2]

in_intensitymap_file.desc: name of file/files containing initial intensity mapping usually generated by previous fnirt run

inmask_file.desc: name of file with mask in input image space

inmask_val.desc: Value to mask out in --in image. Default =0.0

intensity_mapping_order.desc: Order of poynomial for mapping intensities, default 5

inwarp_file.desc: name of file containing initial non-linear warps

jacobian_file.desc: name of file for writing out the Jacobian of the field (for diagnostic or VBM purposes)

jacobian_range.desc: Allowed range of Jacobian determinants, default 0.01, 100.0

max_nonlin_iter.desc: Max # of non-linear iterations list, default [5, 5, 5, 5]

modulatedref_file.desc: name of file for writing out intensity modulated --ref (for diagnostic purposes)

out_intensitymap_file.desc: name of files for writing information pertaining to intensity mapping

ref_fwhm.desc: FWHM (in mm) of gaussian smoothing kernel for ref volume, default [4, 2, 0, 0]

refmask_file.desc: name of file with mask in reference space

refmask_val.desc: Value to mask out in --ref image. Default =0.0

regularization_lambda.desc: Weight of regularisation, default depending on --ssqlambda and --regmod switches. See user documentation.

regularization_model.desc: Model for regularisation of warp-field [membrane_energy bending_energy], default bending_energy

skip_implicit_in_masking.desc: skip implicit masking  based on value in --in image. Default = 0

skip_implicit_ref_masking.desc: skip implicit masking  based on value in --ref image. Default = 0

skip_inmask.desc: skip specified inmask if set, default false

skip_lambda_ssq.desc: If true, lambda is not weighted by current ssq, default false

skip_refmask.desc: Skip specified refmask if set, default false

spline_order.desc: Order of spline, 2->Qadratic spline, 3->Cubic spline. Default=3

warp_resolution.desc: (approximate) resolution (in mm) of warp basis in x-, y- and z-direction, default 10, 10, 10

description: FSL FNIRT wrapper for non-linear registration
